papers.title_en: Multi-Axis Max@K Reinforcement Learning for Representative Diversity in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Ku Onoda, Paavo Parmas, Hiroki Furuta, Soichiro Nishimori, Yuta Oshima, Shohei Taniguchi, Yutaka Matsuo
papers.evidence: 直接应用强化学习提高文本到图像生成的多样性
papers.tldr: 文本到图像模型生成的图像常缺乏多样性，尤其在人物提示中可能放大人口统计偏差。本文形式化目标模态覆盖问题，提出多轴max@K强化学习目标：对一组样本，先取每个类别的组内最大值再求和，仅当样本提升某类别组最大值时才给予正权重。在SD3.5-M模型上，该方法在三个自动评估器中使公平性评分提升0.23-0.36，同时保持图像质量和文本对齐。该工作为提升生成模型的代表多样性提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) models can synthesize realistic, prompt-aligned images, yet samples generated for the same prompt often cover only a small subset of visually distinct modes. This limits the diversity of images, and for person-centric prompts, can reflect or amplify demographic skew. We formalize this problem as coverage of a predefined set of semantically specified modes, which we call target-mode coverage. We then propose multi-axis max@K, a group-based reinforcement learning objective for improving such coverage in diffusion-based T2I models. Given a group of samples and one score per target category, multi-axis max@K first takes the maximum score across samples for each category and then sums these category-wise maxima. The resulting credit assignment gives a sample positive weight on a category only when it increases that category's group-wise maximum, allowing different samples to contribute to different categories. We first validate the credit-assignment mechanism on a synthetic mixture and on SD3.5-M using deterministic pixel-based color rewards. We then evaluate the same objective on perceived-appearance fairness. Across three automatic evaluators on held-out prompts, multi-axis max@K improves the Fairness Score by 0.23-0.36 relative to the base model, while maintaining image quality and text alignment.

papers.title_en: MeanFlowNFT: Bringing Forward-Process RL to Average-Velocity Generators
papers.authors: Yushi Huang, Xiangxin Zhou, Jun Zhang, Liefeng Bo, Tianyu Pang
papers.evidence: 将前向过程强化学习应用于平均速度图像生成器
papers.tldr: MeanFlow生成器通过预测平均速度实现快速少步采样，但现有RL对齐方法仅适用于瞬时速度。本文提出MeanFlowNFT，利用MeanFlow恒等式构建诱导瞬时速度预测器，在其上应用DiffusionNFT目标优化，采样仍用平均速度，保留快速生成优势。实验表明，该框架在图像和视频生成上一致提升基线，在SD3.5-M上8个指标中6个超越SOTA，在Wan 2.1上4步采样达到VBench 84.33，超过50步RL模型，并严格继承了策略改进保证。
papers.abstract_en: MeanFlow generators achieve fast few-step sampling by predicting average velocities over time intervals, making them attractive for efficient generation. Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a powerful way to align diffusion and flow models with human preferences and task-specific objectives. In particular, DiffusionNFT offers an efficient forward-process RL framework that does not require reverse-process trajectories or likelihood estimation. However, applying such RL methods to MeanFlow remains underexplored. DiffusionNFT optimizes instantaneous velocities, whereas MeanFlow samples with average velocities. To bridge this gap, we introduce MeanFlowNFT. Inspired by the MeanFlow identity, which bridges average and instantaneous velocities, we construct an induced instantaneous-velocity predictor. We apply the DiffusionNFT objective to this predictor, making reward optimization well-defined for MeanFlow. Sampling remains based on the average velocity, preserving MeanFlow's fast few-step generation. We further prove that MeanFlowNFT inherits DiffusionNFT's strict policy-improvement guarantee. Experiments on image and video generation show that MeanFlowNFT consistently improves baselines. Moreover, it outperforms prior state-of-the-art RL-tuned few-step generators on most metrics ($6$ of $8$ on SD3.5-M), and can even surpass multi-step RL-tuned diffusion while using only a few sampling steps. For instance, on Wan 2.1, $4$-step MeanFlowNFT reaches a VBench score of $84.33$, surpassing $50$-step LongCat-Video RL ($82.57$).

papers.title_en: MagicPrompt: Ultra-Lightweight Prompt Tuning for Video Generation
papers.authors: Yinhan Zhang, Dinwei Tan, Xianghao Kong, Yue Ma, Yeying Jin, Anyi Rao
papers.evidence: 提出奖励优化方法用于视频生成，可迁移至图像生成奖励设计
papers.tldr: 大规模视频扩散模型全微调成本高昂，现有参数高效微调方法在十亿级模型上仍需大量参数且优化不稳定。MagicPrompt采用注意力嵌入式提示调优，仅需极少量软提示参数即可引导生成，并提出双空间奖励反馈优化，利用自监督潜在目标稳定训练。该方法以低于1%的可训练参数达到竞争性能，显著降低训练成本。其轻量框架实现了极端参数效率与稳定奖励优化，为视频生成任务提供了高效微调方案。
papers.abstract_en: Large-scale video diffusion models (VDMs) deliver strong generation performance, but full fine-tuning for downstream tasks incurs prohibitive computational costs. Existing parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods have two critical flaws on billion-scale models: they still require substantial trainable parameters, and reward-based training suffers from noise-induced optimization instability in condition-guided tasks. We propose MagicPrompt, a lightweight framework that achieves extreme parameter efficiency and stable reward optimization. It first adopts Attention-Embedded Prompt Tuning, which steers generation via lightweight soft prompts with orders of magnitude fewer parameters while preserving pre-trained knowledge. It further introduces Dual-Space Reward Feedback Optimization, which uses self-supervised latent objectives to improve condition-guided reward training. Experiments show MagicPrompt reaches competitive performance with less than 1\% trainable parameters and notably reduces training costs.

papers.title_en: Beyond Entropy: Correctness-Aware Advantage Shaping via Contrastive Policy Optimization
papers.authors: Weiwen Xu, Jia Liu, Hou Pong Chan, Long Li, Deng Cai, Min Chen, Hao Zhang
papers.evidence: 提出一种用于可验证奖励强化学习的优势塑造方法，可迁移至生成任务中的奖励函数设计
papers.tldr: 现有强化学习优势塑形依赖熵，但熵无法区分有用不确定性和有害混淆。本文提出Contrastive Policy Optimization (CPO)，利用参考引导与普通生成分布间的对比差异作为正确性信号。理论和实验表明该差异可靠指示token级正确性，在多个基准上显著优于基于熵的方法，并解决了零优势问题。CPO统一了On-policy Distillation，并揭示了正确与错误响应分别促进探索与利用的机制，平衡两者达到最佳性能。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) commonly uses entropy for advantage shaping. However, entropy cannot distinguish useful uncertainty from detrimental confusion, limiting its effectiveness as a correctness signal. We propose Contrastive Policy Optimization (CPO), which uses token-level contrastive disagreement between reference-guided and vanilla generation distributions for correctness-aware advantage shaping. Both theoretical and empirical results show that this disagreement reliably indicates token-level correctness. We further show that On-policy Distillation is a special case of CPO, where the posterior distribution is instantiated by an external teacher model. CPO also resolves the zero-advantage problem. Experiments on in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks demonstrate that CPO substantially outperforms entropy-based RLVR methods while maintaining strong generalization. Further analysis shows that correct and incorrect responses naturally support exploration and exploitation respectively, and balancing both leads to the best performance.
